mapper.select: with i as (insert into lms_o_setting (tenant_id) values (#{tid}) on conflict (tenant_id) do nothing returning *) select to_jsonb(s) - 'tenant_id' j from (select * from i union all select * from lms_o_setting where tenant_id = #{tid}) s limit 1

update lms_o_setting set limit_tokens = cast(#{limit_tokens} as bigint), alert_pct = cast(#{alert_pct} as int), hard_block = cast(#{hard_block} as boolean) where tenant_id = #{tid} returning to_jsonb(lms_o_setting) - 'tenant_id' j
update lms_o_setting set embed = cast(#{embed} as jsonb) where tenant_id = #{tid} returning to_jsonb(lms_o_setting) - 'tenant_id' j

select jsonb_build_object('month', to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM'), 'used', coalesce(sum(tin + tout), 0)::bigint) j from lms_o_llm_call where tenant_id = #{tid} and at >= (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('month', a.month, 'level', a.level, 'used', a.used, 'limit_tokens', a.limit_tokens, 'at', a.at) order by a.id desc), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select * from lms_o_alert where tenant_id = #{tid} order by id desc limit 50) a

insert into lms_o_alert (tenant_id, month, level, used, limit_tokens) values (#{tid}, cast(#{month} as text), cast(#{level} as text), cast(#{used} as bigint), cast(#{limit_tokens} as bigint)) on conflict (tenant_id, month, level) do nothing returning to_jsonb(true) j

insert into lms_o_provider (tenant_id, kind, name, model) select #{tid}, 'anthropic', 'Anthropic Claude(상용)', 'claude-haiku-5-5' where not exists (select 1 from lms_o_provider where tenant_id = #{tid}) returning to_jsonb(true) j

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at, x.provider_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('provider_id', p.provider_id, 'kind', p.kind, 'name', p.name, 'endpoint_url', p.endpoint_url, 'model', p.model, 'enabled', p.enabled, 'created_at', p.created_at) j, p.created_at, p.provider_id from lms_o_provider p where p.tenant_id = #{tid}) x
select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(feature, provider_id), '{}'::jsonb) j from lms_o_route where tenant_id = #{tid}

insert into lms_o_provider (tenant_id, kind, name, endpoint_url, model, enabled) values (#{tid}, cast(#{kind} as text), cast(#{name} as text), cast(#{endpoint_url} as text), cast(#{model} as text), cast(#{enabled} as boolean)) returning jsonb_build_object('provider_id', provider_id, 'kind', kind, 'name', name, 'endpoint_url', endpoint_url, 'model', model, 'enabled', enabled, 'created_at', created_at) j

update lms_o_provider p set kind = cast(#{kind} as text), name = cast(#{name} as text), endpoint_url = cast(#{endpoint_url} as text), model = cast(#{model} as text), enabled = cast(#{enabled} as boolean) where p.tenant_id = #{tid} and p.provider_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning jsonb_build_object('provider_id', p.provider_id, 'kind', p.kind, 'name', p.name, 'endpoint_url', p.endpoint_url, 'model', p.model, 'enabled', p.enabled, 'created_at', p.created_at) j
with d as (delete from lms_o_provider where tenant_id = #{tid} and provider_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from d

insert into lms_o_route (tenant_id, feature, provider_id) select #{tid}, cast(#{feature} as text), provider_id from lms_o_provider where tenant_id = #{tid} and provider_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) on conflict (tenant_id, feature) do update set provider_id = excluded.provider_id returning to_jsonb(true) j
with d as (delete from lms_o_route where tenant_id = #{tid} and feature = cast(#{feature} as text) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from d

select jsonb_build_object('provider_id', p.provider_id, 'kind', p.kind, 'name', p.name, 'endpoint_url', p.endpoint_url, 'model', p.model, 'enabled', p.enabled, 'created_at', p.created_at) j from lms_o_provider p where p.tenant_id = #{tid} and p.enabled order by (p.provider_id = (select r.provider_id from lms_o_route r where r.tenant_id = #{tid} and r.feature = cast(#{feature} as text))) desc nulls last, (p.kind = 'anthropic') desc, p.created_at, p.provider_id limit 1
select coalesce(doc->'org'->'room', 'null'::jsonb) j from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
insert into ai_usage (tenant_id, day, calls) values (#{tid}, cast(#{day} as date), 1) on conflict (tenant_id, day) do update set calls = ai_usage.calls + 1 returning to_jsonb(calls) j

with u as (update ai_usage set tin = tin + cast(#{tin} as int), tout = tout + cast(#{tout} as int) where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = cast(#{day} as date) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from u

insert into lms_o_llm_call (tenant_id, provider_kind, model, feature, ms, tin, tout, ok, err) values (#{tid}, cast(#{kind} as text), cast(#{model} as text), cast(#{feature} as text), cast(#{ms} as int), cast(#{tin} as int), cast(#{tout} as int), cast(#{ok} as boolean), cast(#{err} as text)) returning to_jsonb(true) j

select jsonb_build_object('days', cast(#{days} as int), 'rows', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.calls desc, r.model, r.feature) from (select provider_kind, model, count(*)::int calls, (count(*) filter (where not ok))::int errors, coalesce(round(avg(ms)), 0)::int avg_ms, coalesce((percentile_disc(0.95) within group (order by ms)), 0)::int p95_ms, sum(tin)::int tin, sum(tout)::int tout, feature from lms_o_llm_call where tenant_id = #{tid} and at > now() - make_interval(days => cast(#{days} as int)) group by provider_kind, model, feature) r), '[]'::jsonb), 'models', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) order by m.calls desc, m.model) from (select provider_kind, model, count(*)::int calls, (count(*) filter (where not ok))::int errors, coalesce(round(avg(ms)), 0)::int avg_ms, coalesce((percentile_disc(0.95) within group (order by ms)), 0)::int p95_ms, sum(tin)::int tin, sum(tout)::int tout from lms_o_llm_call where tenant_id = #{tid} and at > now() - make_interval(days => cast(#{days} as int)) group by provider_kind, model) m), '[]'::jsonb), 'daily', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) order by d.day) from (select ((at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date)::text as day, count(*)::int calls, sum(tin + tout)::int tokens, coalesce(round(avg(ms)), 0)::int avg_ms from lms_o_llm_call where tenant_id = #{tid} and at > now() - make_interval(days => cast(#{days} as int)) group by 1) d), '[]'::jsonb)) j

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at, x.source_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('source_id', s.source_id, 'name', s.name, 'kind', s.kind, 'section_id', s.section_id, 'url', s.url, 'enabled', s.enabled, 'indexed_at', s.indexed_at, 'created_at', s.created_at, 'state', case when s.kind in ('url', 'board') then 'pending' else 'ready' end, 'docs', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_doc d where d.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and d.source_id = s.source_id)) j, s.created_at, s.source_id from lms_o_source s where s.tenant_id = #{tid}) x

insert into lms_o_source (tenant_id, name, kind, section_id, url, enabled) values (#{tid}, cast(#{name} as text), cast(#{kind} as text), cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{url} as text), cast(#{enabled} as boolean)) returning to_jsonb(source_id) j

select jsonb_build_object('source_id', s.source_id, 'name', s.name, 'kind', s.kind, 'section_id', s.section_id, 'url', s.url, 'enabled', s.enabled, 'indexed_at', s.indexed_at, 'created_at', s.created_at, 'state', case when s.kind in ('url', 'board') then 'pending' else 'ready' end, 'docs', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_doc d where d.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and d.source_id = s.source_id)) j from lms_o_source s where s.tenant_id = #{tid} and s.source_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)

update lms_o_source set name = coalesce(cast(#{name} as text), name), enabled = coalesce(cast(#{enabled} as boolean), enabled) where tenant_id = #{tid} and source_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning to_jsonb(source_id) j
with d as (delete from lms_o_source where tenant_id = #{tid} and source_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from d
update lms_o_source set indexed_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and source_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning to_jsonb(true) j

insert into lms_o_doc (tenant_id, source_id, section_id, name, ext, bytes, chars, paras, created_by) values (#{tid}, cast(#{source_id} as uuid), cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{name} as text), cast(#{ext} as text), cast(#{bytes} as int), cast(#{chars} as int), cast(#{paras} as jsonb), cast(#{email} as text)) returning to_jsonb(doc_id) j

with i as (insert into lms_o_chunk (tenant_id, doc_id, seq, text, vec) select #{tid}, cast(#{doc_id} as uuid), (e->>'seq')::int, e->>'text', lms_o_vec(array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(e->'tf'))::int[]) from jsonb_array_elements(cast(#{rows} as jsonb)) e returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from i

select jsonb_build_object('doc_id', d.doc_id, 'source_id', d.source_id, 'section_id', d.section_id, 'name', d.name, 'ext', d.ext, 'bytes', d.bytes, 'chars', d.chars, 'paras_n', jsonb_array_length(d.paras), 'created_by', d.created_by, 'created_at', d.created_at, 'chunks', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_chunk k where k.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and k.doc_id = d.doc_id)) || jsonb_build_object('paras', d.paras) j from lms_o_doc d where d.tenant_id = #{tid} and d.doc_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at desc, x.doc_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('doc_id', d.doc_id, 'source_id', d.source_id, 'section_id', d.section_id, 'name', d.name, 'ext', d.ext, 'bytes', d.bytes, 'chars', d.chars, 'paras_n', jsonb_array_length(d.paras), 'created_by', d.created_by, 'created_at', d.created_at, 'chunks', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_chunk k where k.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and k.doc_id = d.doc_id)) j, d.created_at, d.doc_id from lms_o_doc d where d.tenant_id = #{tid} and (cast(#{source_id} as uuid) is null or d.source_id = cast(#{source_id} as uuid)) and (cast(#{section_id} as uuid) is null or d.section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid)) order by d.created_at desc limit 300) x
with d as (delete from lms_o_doc where tenant_id = #{tid} and doc_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from d

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('doc_id', h.doc_id, 'name', h.name, 'seq', h.seq, 'score', h.score, 'text', h.text) order by h.score desc, h.name, h.doc_id, h.seq), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select k.doc_id, d.name, k.seq, lms_o_cos(k.vec, lms_o_vec(cast(#{tf} as int[]))) score, left(k.text, 600) as text from lms_o_chunk k join lms_o_doc d on d.tenant_id = k.tenant_id and d.doc_id = k.doc_id left join lms_o_source s on s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and s.source_id = d.source_id where k.tenant_id = #{tid} and (s.source_id is null or s.enabled) and (cast(#{secs} as jsonb) is null or d.section_id is null or d.section_id::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(cast(#{secs} as jsonb)))) order by score desc, d.name, k.doc_id, k.seq limit cast(#{k} as int)) h where h.score > 0

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('faq_id', h.faq_id, 'q', h.q, 'a', h.a, 'score', h.score) order by h.score desc, h.faq_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select d.faq_id, d.q, d.a, lms_o_cos(d.vec, lms_o_vec(cast(#{tf} as int[]))) score from lms_o_faq d where d.tenant_id = #{tid} and (cast(#{secs} as jsonb) is null or d.section_id is null or d.section_id::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(cast(#{secs} as jsonb)))) order by score desc, d.faq_id limit cast(#{k} as int)) h where h.score > 0

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at desc, x.faq_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('faq_id', f.faq_id, 'section_id', f.section_id, 'q', f.q, 'a', f.a, 'tags', f.tags, 'created_at', f.created_at) j, f.created_at, f.faq_id from lms_o_faq f where f.tenant_id = #{tid} and (cast(#{section_id} as uuid) is null or f.section_id is null or f.section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid))) x

insert into lms_o_faq (tenant_id, section_id, q, a, tags, vec) values (#{tid}, cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{q} as text), cast(#{a} as text), cast(#{tags} as text), lms_o_vec(cast(#{tf} as int[]))) returning jsonb_build_object('faq_id', faq_id, 'section_id', section_id, 'q', q, 'a', a, 'tags', tags, 'created_at', created_at) j
with d as (delete from lms_o_faq where tenant_id = #{tid} and faq_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from d

select jsonb_build_object('member_no', p.member_no, 'kind', p.kind, 'unit_code', p.unit_code, 'status', p.status, 'sections', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('section_id', s.section_id, 'title', s.title, 'course_code', s.course_code, 'term_id', s.term_id, 'section_no', s.section_no) order by s.term_id, s.course_code, s.section_no) from lms_section s where s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id and (exists (select 1 from lms_enrollment e where e.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and e.section_id = s.section_id and e.person_id = p.person_id and e.status = 'enrolled') or exists (select 1 from lms_section_staff f where f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and f.section_id = s.section_id and f.person_id = p.person_id))), '[]'::jsonb)) j from lms_person p where p.tenant_id = #{tid} and p.member_no = cast(#{member_no} as text)

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('section_id', s.section_id, 'title', s.title, 'course_code', s.course_code, 'term_id', s.term_id, 'section_no', s.section_no, 'students', (select count(*)::int from lms_enrollment e where e.tenant_id = s.tenant_id and e.section_id = s.section_id and e.status = 'enrolled')) order by s.term_id desc, s.course_code, s.section_no), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select * from lms_section where tenant_id = #{tid} and status <> 'archived' order by term_id desc, course_code, section_no limit 300) s

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.updated_at desc, x.thread_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('thread_id', t.thread_id, 'title', t.title, 'owner', t.owner, 'section_id', t.section_id, 'member_no', t.member_no, 'temperature', t.temperature, 'top_k', t.top_k, 'shared', t.share_token is not null, 'share_token', t.share_token, 'created_at', t.created_at, 'updated_at', t.updated_at, 'msgs', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_msg m where m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and m.thread_id = t.thread_id)) j, t.updated_at, t.thread_id from lms_o_thread t where t.tenant_id = #{tid} and (t.owner = cast(#{email} as text) or t.share_token is not null) and (cast(#{section_id} as uuid) is null or t.section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid)) order by t.updated_at desc limit 100) x

insert into lms_o_thread (tenant_id, title, owner, section_id, member_no, temperature, top_k) values (#{tid}, cast(#{title} as text), cast(#{email} as text), cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{member_no} as text), cast(#{temperature} as real), cast(#{top_k} as int)) returning to_jsonb(thread_id) j

select jsonb_build_object('thread_id', t.thread_id, 'title', t.title, 'owner', t.owner, 'section_id', t.section_id, 'member_no', t.member_no, 'temperature', t.temperature, 'top_k', t.top_k, 'shared', t.share_token is not null, 'share_token', t.share_token, 'created_at', t.created_at, 'updated_at', t.updated_at, 'msgs', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_msg m where m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and m.thread_id = t.thread_id)) j from lms_o_thread t where t.tenant_id = #{tid} and t.thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)

select jsonb_build_object('thread_id', t.thread_id, 'title', t.title, 'owner', t.owner, 'section_id', t.section_id, 'member_no', t.member_no, 'temperature', t.temperature, 'top_k', t.top_k, 'shared', t.share_token is not null, 'share_token', t.share_token, 'created_at', t.created_at, 'updated_at', t.updated_at, 'msgs', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_msg m where m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and m.thread_id = t.thread_id)) j from lms_o_thread t where t.tenant_id = #{tid} and t.share_token = cast(#{token} as text)

update lms_o_thread set title = coalesce(cast(#{title} as text), title), temperature = coalesce(cast(#{temperature} as real), temperature), top_k = coalesce(cast(#{top_k} as int), top_k), share_token = case when cast(#{shared} as boolean) is null then share_token when cast(#{shared} as boolean) then coalesce(share_token, cast(#{token} as text)) else null end, updated_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning to_jsonb(thread_id) j

update lms_o_thread set updated_at = now(), title = case when title = '새 대화' then cast(#{title} as text) else title end where tenant_id = #{tid} and thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning to_jsonb(true) j
with d as (delete from lms_o_thread where tenant_id = #{tid} and thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning 1) select to_jsonb(count(*)::int) j from d

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.seq), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('seq', m.seq, 'role', m.role, 'content', m.content, 'cites', m.cites, 'faq_id', m.faq_id, 'edited', m.edited, 'at', m.at) j, m.seq from lms_o_msg m where m.tenant_id = #{tid} and m.thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)) x

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.seq), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('role', m.role, 'content', m.content) j, m.seq from (select * from lms_o_msg where tenant_id = #{tid} and thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) order by seq desc limit 6) m) x

insert into lms_o_msg (tenant_id, thread_id, seq, role, content, cites, faq_id) select #{tid}, cast(#{id} as uuid), coalesce(max(seq), 0) + 1, cast(#{role} as text), cast(#{content} as text), cast(#{cites} as jsonb), cast(#{faq_id} as uuid) from lms_o_msg where tenant_id = #{tid} and thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning jsonb_build_object('seq', seq, 'role', role, 'content', content, 'cites', cites, 'faq_id', faq_id, 'edited', edited, 'at', at) j

update lms_o_msg m set content = cast(#{content} as text), edited = true where m.tenant_id = #{tid} and m.thread_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and m.seq = cast(#{seq} as int) returning jsonb_build_object('seq', m.seq, 'role', m.role, 'content', m.content, 'cites', m.cites, 'faq_id', m.faq_id, 'edited', m.edited, 'at', m.at) j

insert into lms_o_gen (tenant_id, kind, section_id, doc_id, lang, params, output, parsed, created_by) values (#{tid}, cast(#{kind} as text), cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{doc_id} as uuid), cast(#{lang} as text), cast(#{params} as jsonb), cast(#{output} as jsonb), cast(#{parsed} as boolean), cast(#{email} as text)) returning to_jsonb(gen_id) j

select jsonb_build_object('gen_id', g.gen_id, 'kind', g.kind, 'section_id', g.section_id, 'doc_id', g.doc_id, 'lang', g.lang, 'params', g.params, 'output', g.output, 'parsed', g.parsed, 'status', g.status, 'created_by', g.created_by, 'reviewer', g.reviewer, 'review_note', g.review_note, 'created_at', g.created_at, 'reviewed_at', g.reviewed_at, 'published_at', g.published_at, 'ai_generated', true) j from lms_o_gen g where g.tenant_id = #{tid} and g.gen_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at desc, x.gen_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('gen_id', g.gen_id, 'kind', g.kind, 'section_id', g.section_id, 'doc_id', g.doc_id, 'lang', g.lang, 'params', g.params, 'output', g.output, 'parsed', g.parsed, 'status', g.status, 'created_by', g.created_by, 'reviewer', g.reviewer, 'review_note', g.review_note, 'created_at', g.created_at, 'reviewed_at', g.reviewed_at, 'published_at', g.published_at, 'ai_generated', true) j, g.created_at, g.gen_id from lms_o_gen g where g.tenant_id = #{tid} and (cast(#{kind} as text) is null or g.kind = cast(#{kind} as text)) and (cast(#{status} as text) is null or g.status = cast(#{status} as text)) and (cast(#{section_id} as uuid) is null or g.section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid)) order by g.created_at desc limit 200) x

update lms_o_gen set output = cast(#{output} as jsonb), parsed = true, status = 'review' where tenant_id = #{tid} and gen_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and status in ('review', 'rejected') returning to_jsonb(gen_id) j

update lms_o_gen set status = cast(#{to} as text), reviewer = cast(#{email} as text), review_note = coalesce(cast(#{note} as text), review_note), reviewed_at = case when cast(#{to} as text) in ('approved', 'rejected') then now() else reviewed_at end, published_at = case when cast(#{to} as text) = 'published' then now() else published_at end where tenant_id = #{tid} and gen_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and status in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(cast(#{from} as jsonb))) returning to_jsonb(gen_id) j

insert into lms_o_eval (tenant_id, section_id, member_no, rubric_gen_id, answer_chars, max_score, ai_score, rationale, criteria) values (#{tid}, cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{member_no} as text), cast(#{rubric_gen_id} as uuid), cast(#{answer_chars} as int), cast(#{max_score} as float8), cast(#{ai_score} as float8), cast(#{rationale} as text), cast(#{criteria} as jsonb)) returning to_jsonb(eval_id) j

select jsonb_build_object('eval_id', e.eval_id, 'section_id', e.section_id, 'member_no', e.member_no, 'rubric_gen_id', e.rubric_gen_id, 'answer_chars', e.answer_chars, 'max_score', e.max_score, 'ai_score', e.ai_score, 'rationale', e.rationale, 'criteria', e.criteria, 'status', e.status, 'final_score', e.final_score, 'confirmed_by', e.confirmed_by, 'created_at', e.created_at, 'confirmed_at', e.confirmed_at, 'recorded', 'lms_only') j from lms_o_eval e where e.tenant_id = #{tid} and e.eval_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at desc, x.eval_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('eval_id', e.eval_id, 'section_id', e.section_id, 'member_no', e.member_no, 'rubric_gen_id', e.rubric_gen_id, 'answer_chars', e.answer_chars, 'max_score', e.max_score, 'ai_score', e.ai_score, 'rationale', e.rationale, 'criteria', e.criteria, 'status', e.status, 'final_score', e.final_score, 'confirmed_by', e.confirmed_by, 'created_at', e.created_at, 'confirmed_at', e.confirmed_at, 'recorded', 'lms_only') j, e.created_at, e.eval_id from lms_o_eval e where e.tenant_id = #{tid} and (cast(#{section_id} as uuid) is null or e.section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid)) order by e.created_at desc limit 300) x

update lms_o_eval set status = 'confirmed', final_score = cast(#{score} as float8), confirmed_by = cast(#{email} as text), confirmed_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and eval_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning to_jsonb(eval_id) j

with sec as (select * from lms_section where tenant_id = #{tid} and section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid)), ses as (select count(*)::int n from lms_session x where x.tenant_id = #{tid} and x.section_id = cast(#{section_id} as uuid) and x.kind <> 'holiday'), st as (select p.member_no, p.unit_code, att.present, att.late, att.absent, att.excused, gr.avg_pct, gr.items from sec join lms_enrollment e on e.tenant_id = sec.tenant_id and e.section_id = sec.section_id and e.status = 'enrolled' join lms_person p on p.tenant_id = e.tenant_id and p.person_id = e.person_id cross join lateral (select (count(*) filter (where a.status = 'present'))::int present, (count(*) filter (where a.status = 'late'))::int late, (count(*) filter (where a.status = 'absent'))::int absent, (count(*) filter (where a.status = 'excused'))::int excused from lms_attendance a join lms_session x on x.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and x.session_id = a.session_id where a.tenant_id = sec.tenant_id and x.section_id = sec.section_id and a.person_id = p.person_id) att cross join lateral (select round(avg(g.score / nullif(i.max_score, 0) * 100), 1)::float8 avg_pct, count(g.score)::int items from lms_grade_score g join lms_grade_item i on i.tenant_id = g.tenant_id and i.item_id = g.item_id where g.tenant_id = sec.tenant_id and i.section_id = sec.section_id and g.person_id = p.person_id) gr), st2 as (select st.*, case when ses.n = 0 then null else round((st.present + st.late + st.excused) * 100.0 / ses.n)::int end att_rate from st, ses), st3 as (select st2.*, case when (att_rate is not null and att_rate < 75) or (avg_pct is not null and avg_pct < 60) then 'risk' when (att_rate is not null and att_rate < 85) or (avg_pct is not null and avg_pct < 70) then 'watch' else 'ok' end risk from st2) select (select jsonb_build_object('section', jsonb_build_object('section_id', sec.section_id, 'title', sec.title, 'course_code', sec.course_code, 'term_id', sec.term_id), 'sessions', (select n from ses), 'students', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(st3) order by st3.member_no) from st3), '[]'::jsonb), 'summary', jsonb_build_object('n', (select count(*)::int from st3), 'risk', (select count(*)::int from st3 where risk = 'risk'), 'watch', (select count(*)::int from st3 where risk = 'watch'), 'ok', (select count(*)::int from st3 where risk = 'ok'))) from sec) j

insert into lms_o_caption_room (tenant_id, section_id, title, langs, code) values (#{tid}, cast(#{section_id} as uuid), cast(#{title} as text), cast(#{langs} as jsonb), cast(#{code} as text)) returning to_jsonb(room_id) j

select jsonb_build_object('room_id', r.room_id, 'section_id', r.section_id, 'title', r.title, 'langs', r.langs, 'code', r.code, 'status', r.status, 'created_at', r.created_at, 'lines', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_caption_line l where l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and l.room_id = r.room_id)) j from lms_o_caption_room r where r.tenant_id = #{tid} and r.room_id = cast(#{id} as uuid)

select jsonb_build_object('room_id', r.room_id, 'section_id', r.section_id, 'title', r.title, 'langs', r.langs, 'code', r.code, 'status', r.status, 'created_at', r.created_at, 'lines', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_caption_line l where l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and l.room_id = r.room_id)) j from lms_o_caption_room r where r.tenant_id = #{tid} and r.code = cast(#{code} as text)

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.created_at desc, x.room_id), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('room_id', r.room_id, 'section_id', r.section_id, 'title', r.title, 'langs', r.langs, 'code', r.code, 'status', r.status, 'created_at', r.created_at, 'lines', (select count(*)::int from lms_o_caption_line l where l.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and l.room_id = r.room_id)) j, r.created_at, r.room_id from lms_o_caption_room r where r.tenant_id = #{tid} order by r.created_at desc limit 100) x

update lms_o_caption_room set status = coalesce(cast(#{status} as text), status), langs = coalesce(cast(#{langs} as jsonb), langs), title = coalesce(cast(#{title} as text), title) where tenant_id = #{tid} and room_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning to_jsonb(room_id) j

insert into lms_o_caption_line (tenant_id, room_id, seq, text, source) select #{tid}, cast(#{id} as uuid), coalesce(max(seq), 0) + 1, cast(#{text} as text), cast(#{source} as text) from lms_o_caption_line where tenant_id = #{tid} and room_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) returning jsonb_build_object('seq', seq, 'text', text, 'tr', tr, 'source', source, 'edited', edited, 'at', at) j

update lms_o_caption_line l set text = coalesce(cast(#{text} as text), l.text), tr = l.tr || coalesce(cast(#{tr} as jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), edited = true where l.tenant_id = #{tid} and l.room_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and l.seq = cast(#{seq} as int) returning jsonb_build_object('seq', l.seq, 'text', l.text, 'tr', l.tr, 'source', l.source, 'edited', l.edited, 'at', l.at) j

select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.seq), '[]'::jsonb) j from (select jsonb_build_object('seq', l.seq, 'text', l.text, 'tr', l.tr, 'source', l.source, 'edited', l.edited, 'at', l.at) j, l.seq from lms_o_caption_line l where l.tenant_id = #{tid} and l.room_id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and l.seq > cast(#{since} as int) order by l.seq limit 500) x
insert into audit_log (tenant_id, actor, action, detail) values (#{tid}, cast(#{actor} as text), cast(#{action} as text), cast(#{detail} as jsonb)) returning to_jsonb(true) j
